items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I remember when Paul left because Paul was with us and he left.

ctx.x: Do you remember much of the bands of King Oliver and the band of the... I didn't know them at all. Do you remember when Paul left and went to join?
I remember when Paul left because Paul was with us and he left.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Who did, do you remember who saw Sam Gartman in this place?

items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Jeanette Sullivan. So we got her to play in the band.

ctx.x: Jeanette Sullivan. So we got her to play in the band. And the band made a great success. The band then, I composed a number and we called it My Josephie. And the number made such a hit with the people that it actually swarmed Ridgely's Tuxedo. Really? By the way Ridgely called his band Ridgely's Tuxedo and Celestad called his band Papa Celestad's Tuxedo. But that Ridgely's Tuxedo band died out of the picture. And all that was left was Papa Celestad's Tuxedo band. So I stayed with Papa Celestad band. All that…
